node.statement: From the chosen receiving-field values, W.c0_cb=c0, W.L=L^0, W.K1=K_1^0, W.K2=max{K_2^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb W.L}, W.K3=max{K_3^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb W.L}, W.e_env=e_env^0, W.e1=e_1, W.e_s2=min{e_s2^0,e_2}, and W.e_cross=min{e_cross^0,e_3}; hence every weak inequality asserted for W in the root follows.
